projects.name: S3-to-Redshift Ingestion & Cost Optimization Platform
details: Description - Worked for the optimized the cost of AWS services and move the file from S3 to Redshift.

Responsibilities- Led performance monitoring and cost optimization initiatives using New Relic and AWS CloudWatch, identifying underutilized resources and optimizing EC2, S3, and RDS usage to reduce cloud expenditure.
Automated data ingestion pipelines to move large files from S3 to Amazon Redshift, improving data availability for analytics and reporting.

projects.name: B2B E-commerce Platform
details: Description - Led the development and management of LG's B2B e-commerce platform. Key responsibilities included implementing product catalog features such as category-based product addition, enabling search functionality based on category and price filters, and managing discount configurations to support dynamic pricing strategies for bulk buyers.
Responsibilities- Own solution architecture, technical design reviews and PoCs for a multi‑tenant e‑commerce & logistics platform handling 20M+ records/day.
Led a team of 8 developers; introduced GitHub Actions + SonarQube pipeline, reducing PR merge time by 35%.

projects.name: Card Grading & Shipping System
details: Description - Designed and implemented a modular card‑grading & shipping module (Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL) that cut manual processing by 40 %.
Responsibilities- Architected and implemented microservices for grading and shipping workflows using Spring Boot.
Integrated Kafka for reliable asynchronous communication between grading, payment, and fulfilment modules.
Designed PostgreSQL schema to support flexible card metadata and audit tracking.
Developed secure RESTful APIs for internal tools and external client systems.
Worked closely with product and operations teams to refine workflows and reduce processing overhead.
Led code reviews, performance tuning, and ensured high service availability.

projects.name: Certificate Ingestion & Visualization Platform
details: Description - Built a certificate ingestion service integrating with legacy systems and persisting artefacts across MySQL, S3 and MongoDB, enabling real‑time dashboard visualization.
Responsibilities- Designed and developed ingestion pipelines to process certificate data from legacy systems.
Implemented secure data storage and retrieval mechanisms using MySQL, MongoDB, and AWS S3.
Exposed RESTful APIs for downstream analytics and dashboard services.
Ensured high availability, data consistency, and encryption of sensitive artifacts.
Collaborated with front-end and DevOps teams to support real-time dashboard integration and CI/CD workflows.
Tuned database queries and storage strategies to support high-volume certificate data with low latency.
